# Vancouver Dragons Rugby League Football Club

> Vancouver's rugby league club since 2012 (also known as the Vancouver Dragons, VRLFC or Vancouver Dragons RLFC). Home games are at Brockton Oval in Stanley Park, Vancouver, BC, Canada. The club is a member of Rugby League BC (RLBC) and won the 2026 RLBC 9s, beating Valley Vipers in the final; the Reserves won the first-ever RLBC Reserve Grade championship the same year.

Key facts:
- Club motto: "Club first. Team second. Self last."
- New and returning players are welcome, including players coming from rugby union. Registration is through Rugby League BC (https://www.rugbyleaguebc.ca/).
- 2027 season outline: pre-season training from April 2027, the RLBC 9s in late May or early June, the regular season in June and July, then semifinals and the Grand Final. Full fixtures are published once Rugby League BC confirms them.
- The club is taking a 9s squad to the Rugby League Vegas 9's in Las Vegas, February 25–26, 2027, and is looking for players and sponsors.
- The club is fully amateur. International players are welcome; players need their own playing health insurance.
- Board: Josh Knight (President), Gregory Crowe (Vice President), Richard Marshall (Treasurer).
- Life members (five): Josh Knight, Gregory Crowe, Scyler Dumas, Ray Bissonette, Paul Fogerty.
- Main contact: secretary@vancouverdragons.ca, or the contact form at https://vancouverdragons.ca/contact/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/vancouver_dragons_/
